name: Personal Calendar LINE operations
type: LINE personal calendar control and evidence-backed task projection
requiresDatabases: Rental Calendar V2 foundation schema with active LINE identity links

dataIsolation.guard: Every request resolves the active project-local Rental identity link from the stable LINE user ID; personal writes require personal_edit, while AM task projections remain view_only and require source evidence.

definitionOfDone: A bound direct-message user can query personal Calendar items through LINE
A bound direct-message user can create an explicitly dated personal item after confirmation
A bound direct-message user can complete, cancel, reschedule, rename, or set a reminder on a personal_edit item
Evidence-backed AM tasks with a due date and an unambiguous explicit owner are projected idempotently as view_only Calendar items
AM source items cannot be modified or cancelled through the personal Calendar commands
The Rental Calendar APIs and AM Platform module are deployed and verified in their own production services
